pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Taraweeh and Witr? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Taraweeh and Witr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Taraweeh and Witr to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taraweeh and Witr.
   D. Say Taraweeh and Witr has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
   C. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Knowledge with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.
   C. Say Hadith on Knowledge has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on Knowledge to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Nullifiers of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Nullifiers of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nullifiers of Swalah.
   C. Say Nullifiers of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Nullifiers of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on good Behaviour.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on good Behaviour with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on good Behaviour to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on good Behaviour has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.
   B. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels.
   D. Say Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
   C. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on good Behaviour and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Greetings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Knowledge and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
